Our Services

One program. Total protection.

The Hive Life is our one-of-a-kind, 6-step treatment program for a pest-free home — fast acting, long-lasting, and family & pet friendly. Our most popular option includes the initial flush-out service, then regularly scheduled treatments starting the month after, to help break down the life cycle of the pests.

The Hive Life — Residential

Year-round protection from 40+ common Arizona pests. Initial flush-out, then regular treatments that break the pests’ life cycle — fully guaranteed.

Commercial Pest Control

We study your business and develop a specialized insect and rodent protection program tailored to your establishment — with online reporting, online bill pay, and email alerts.

Multi-Family Pest Control

Premium commercial pest control for the multi-family industry, serving multiple facilities valley-wide. Just one or two badly infested apartments can spread activity to the whole building — we make sure that never happens.
